Turnbow VIRIN: 260707-D-OZ383-1013 Bruce also answered audience questions, such as on the evolving tactics of adversaries like China, who have moved beyond simple hacking to wage cognitive warfare. By influencing entertainment, media and social platforms, he described the ability to shape thoughts and beliefs as part of a total-war strategy. He also acknowledged the challenge of recruiting and retaining top talent when competing with private sector salaries. Bruce suggested the National Guard and Reserve components offer a way for professionals to serve their country while maintaining successful civilian careers, citing an example of an Air National Guard member who is a senior vice president at a software company. Cybersecurity in the coming years may end up relying more on artificial intelligence augmenting the abilities of traditional analysts. “I think the future of artificial intelligence is also changing how we approach cybersecurity and the humans that will actually do it,” Bruce said. “It's going to be one cybersecurity analyst and about 1,000 AI agents doing the work.” SHARE PRINT Warfighter Talk Campaign of Learning cyber awareness cyber capabil
